acceptance: node tests/unit/scripts/test_comment_syntax_js.cjs runs successfully in any linked worktree without requiring manual COMMENT_POLICY_TYPESCRIPT environment configuration when node_modules is installed in the primary clone.
context: Observed while running test_comment_syntax_js.cjs in linked worktrees. Linked worktrees do not share node_modules by default.
description: Running node tests/unit/scripts/test_comment_syntax_js.cjs in a linked worktree fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND for typescript unless COMMENT_POLICY_TYPESCRIPT is explicitly exported to point at the primary clone's results-explorer/node_modules. Update scripts/comment_syntax_js.cjs to fall back to the primary git repository root's results-explorer/node_modules when run in a linked worktree, or provide a worktree-init helper that symlinks or resolves node_modules.
